title: 黑色大丽花：消失的六天
style_prefix: Photorealistic live-action historical documentary reconstruction, Los Angeles California 1947, horizontal 16:9 cinematic composition, realistic American late-1940s clothing and architecture, natural skin and fabric texture, restrained 35mm film grain, muted warm taupe and cream with cool slate-blue shadows, motivated soft daylight or warm tungsten practical light, deep but readable shadows, realistic period props, smooth slow camera movement, one continuous shot, grounded restrained suspense rather than supernatural horror. chapters.title: 路边的发现
chapters.text: 一九四七年一月十五日，洛杉矶。一位母亲带着孩子经过空地，最初以为路边躺着一个假人。走近后，她才发现，那是一名遇害的年轻女子。更反常的是，现场没有血迹。警方由此判断：这里很可能不是第一现场。是谁，把她带到了这里？

chapters.title: 她的名字
chapters.text: 警方把指纹通过照片传真传给联邦调查局。五十六分钟后，身份得到确认。她叫伊丽莎白·肖特，二十二岁。她曾因求职等原因留下指纹，旧档案认出了她，却指不出凶手。媒体后来给她起了一个名字：黑色大丽花。可一个耸动的称呼，并不能解释她遭遇了什么。调查必须回到她失踪前的生活。

chapters.title: 消失的六天
chapters.text: 警方当年的调查通告，把目光锁定在一月九日至十五日。通告记录，她一月九日曾在比尔特莫尔酒店下车。此后几天，她去了哪里，见过谁？时间线出现了空白。要找到凶手，首先要把这段行踪接起来，而不是用传闻填满它。

chapters.title: 信与指纹
chapters.text: 随后，一封匿名信带来了新的希望。它会不会来自凶手？联邦调查局尝试比对信上的指纹，却没有在档案中找到匹配。信是谁寄的，依然不能确定。另一方面，警方怀疑作案者可能具有解剖技能，于是扩大调查范围。但怀疑，并不是证据。

chapters.title: 线索不是定论
chapters.text: 调查人员核查嫌疑人的记录，并在美国多地展开访谈。线索不断增加，却始终没能把身份、地点和作案过程连成一条可证实的链。几十年里，各种理论轮番出现。有人指向某个嫌疑人，有人声称已经破案。可一个讲得通的故事，不等于一个被证明的事实。

chapters.title: 仍然未解
chapters.text: 我们能够确认的，是她的身份、遗体被发现的日期，以及调查留下的缺口。按照联邦调查局公布的案件资料，这起谋杀案仍未侦破。悬念没有一个可以负责任写下的凶手名字。而在所有传说之前，应该被记住的，是一个真实的人。伊丽莎白·肖特。她只有二十二岁。

shots.prompt: Wide establishing view of a quiet undeveloped Los Angeles residential block at overcast winter dawn, low stucco bungalows and distant palms, dry weeds on a vacant lot beside a concrete sidewalk. No people visible. Start wide and slowly dolly toward the empty lot; end on the sidewalk edge.
shots.purpose: 日期、地点建立；不先展示尸体
shots.transition_out: 沿人行道视线匹配硬切

shots.prompt: One adult mother in a simple camel wool coat stands still on that concrete sidewalk, seen in medium profile; her small child remains safely behind her mostly outside frame. She notices something OFF SCREEN to the right, stops, and her expression changes from uncertainty to quiet alarm. Do not show what she sees. Camera gently pushes toward her face; her gaze stays screen-right.
shots.purpose: 母亲发现异常；只拍反应
shots.transition_out: 视线切向事实卡，省略暴力画面

shots.purpose: 不展示遗体，以事实卡确认发现事件
shots.transition_out: 低频音桥带入地面特写

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. He kneels at the edge of the same dry vacant lot in soft overcast morning light and calmly examines ordinary earth and short grass, then glances at a small blank notepad. The foreground contains only undisturbed earth, no body, no fabric covering a body, no blood. Low close shot of ground and sleeve, subtle lateral drift.
shots.purpose: 现场无血迹；不把视觉重现当证据照片
shots.transition_out: 地面近景切回空地全景

shots.prompt: High wide oblique view of the same empty vacant lot beside the pale sidewalk and a quiet 1940s Los Angeles residential street, exactly one parked late-1940s dark sedan far in the background, no driver and no suspect, no body. Very slow crane rise reveals the surrounding street, creating a spatial question, not a reconstruction of the crime.
shots.purpose: 由发现地过渡到第一现场疑问
shots.transition_out: 纸张声提前0.2秒进入下一组镜头

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. Macro view of an authentic-looking inked fingerprint card as a single white cotton-gloved hand slides it gently under a small magnifying lens. Only abstract fingerprint ridges, no readable writing. Begin on the card edge, end on the fingerprint ridge pattern. Warm lamp and cool window light.
shots.purpose: 指纹辨认身份
shots.transition_out: 动作匹配剪辑：纸卡→传真纸

shots.prompt: Close view of a 1940s newspaper wirephoto transmitter in a modest American office, a metal rotating drum holding a paper photograph and a mechanical scanning arm moving slowly. A period black telephone sits out of focus, no screens, no digital controls. One continuous side dolly from drum to receiving paper; no legible text.
shots.purpose: 照片传真；避免现代设备穿帮
shots.transition_out: 机械声延续到56分钟信息卡

shots.purpose: 身份确认关键数字；来源FBI
shots.transition_out: 卡片浅色背景匹配人物脸部亮部

shots.purpose: 用警方通告中的档案肖像介绍真实身份；排除外观偏成熟的AI试片
shots.transition_out: 旁白连续，肖像切报刊印刷
shots.original_ai_prompt: An illustrative adult woman aged twenty-two, dark shoulder-length 1940s pin curls, fair skin, oval face, modest charcoal wool jacket over an ivory blouse, natural muted lipstick, not an actor impersonation, no glamorous pose. A respectful medium close portrait in a modest 1940s room beside a tall window, looking slightly to camera-left, fully dressed, thoughtful neutral expression, breathing naturally. No danger, no injuries, no other people. Gentle four-inch camera push, do not change facial features or clothing.

shots.prompt: Interior of a 1947 American newspaper printing room, a heavy black rotary printing press slowly turns and carries cream newsprint through rollers. Focus on moving paper and ink texture, entirely illegible print, no fake historical headlines. Camera tracks left to right with the paper. Warm tungsten light.
shots.purpose: 媒体命名；片名后期准确叠加
shots.transition_out: 纸页擦过画面，硬切原始通告式信息卡

shots.purpose: 警方通告给出行踪调查区间
shots.transition_out: 日期线动效带入酒店外景

shots.prompt: Exterior architectural establishing shot inspired by the Los Angeles Biltmore Hotel in 1947: grand cream and terracotta Beaux-Arts facade, tall arched ground-floor entrance, period dark sedan already parked at curb, no modern signs and no readable lettering. Quiet late afternoon, camera slow approach toward the entrance; do not show a specific suspect or meeting.
shots.purpose: 最后已知行踪地点；建筑为重现非测绘
shots.transition_out: 同一入口方向匹配室内走向

shots.prompt: An illustrative adult woman aged twenty-two, dark shoulder-length 1940s pin curls, fair skin, oval face, modest charcoal wool jacket over an ivory blouse, natural muted lipstick, not an actor impersonation, no glamorous pose. Seen only FROM BEHIND in a grand late-1940s hotel lobby with cream stone columns and muted brass fixtures. She walks slowly away from the camera toward a bright doorway, carrying a small brown leather handbag in her right hand. Her dark pin curls and charcoal jacket stay unchanged. Camera follows at shoulder height, no other foreground character and no encounter.
shots.purpose: 只重现到访意象，不虚构失踪后会面
shots.transition_out: 人物离开画面后，切空白时间线

shots.purpose: 明确六天行踪缺口，不编造事件
shots.transition_out: 时间线末端空白匹配档案板缺口

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. He stands alone at a modest cork evidence board beside the desk, mostly rear three-quarter view. Several blank ivory cards and a simple street sketch are spaced apart with a visible empty center. He pauses without drawing an invented connection; slow camera move toward the empty center. No names, no photographs of suspects.
shots.purpose: 调查需要证据填补而非传闻
shots.transition_out: 纸质材料与匿名信作视觉桥

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. Close overhead shot of one closed cream envelope lying diagonally on the ivory folder. No address, no handwriting, no ink marks. The green lamp illuminates one edge and soft window light reveals paper fibers. Camera slowly pushes toward the envelope, no hand in frame, nothing ominous physically happens.
shots.purpose: 匿名信出现；不把寄信者认定为凶手
shots.transition_out: 同一桌面、灯位和信封方向连续

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. A single white cotton-gloved right hand carefully lifts the edge of that same cream envelope using its thumb and forefinger, holding it below a magnifying glass on a stand. Hands remain anatomically normal, no liquid, no chemicals, no hidden weapon. Slow macro focus pull from paper edge to abstract fingerprint ridge texture. No readable text.
shots.purpose: 检查信上指纹；与S06使用同类道具
shots.transition_out: 仅取已检查的前2.0秒动作，提前切后期指纹结果卡

shots.purpose: 区分匿名信与凶手来信；匹配失败不是无指纹
shots.transition_out: 信息卡干净硬切，旁白带入调查方向

匿名信指纹
档案中未找到匹配

shots.prompt: A modest 1947 university medical records room in southern California, one adult male clerk in a plain white laboratory coat searches a wooden index-card cabinet. No surgery, no instruments, no body, no clinical procedure. Camera glides past labeled-but-unreadable drawers toward his hands; neutral daylight, quiet procedural mood.
shots.purpose: 解剖技能仅为调查假设；不影射具体医生
shots.transition_out: 抽屉动作与文件开合匹配剪辑

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. Close shot from behind his shoulder as he lays two blank record cards beside the ivory case folder and compares them under the same green lamp. He does not circle a name or identify anyone. Camera moves subtly sideways to show the gap between cards. Restrained thoughtful gesture.
shots.purpose: 怀疑不等于证据；回到调查线
shots.transition_out: 黑色电话铃轻声提前进入下一段

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. A period black rotary telephone sits beside a simple unlabeled paper map of the United States. One hand in a charcoal suit sleeve lifts the receiver slowly; no face visible. Camera tracks from the map to the receiver. No glowing connections, no digital graphic, only physical period props.
shots.purpose: 多地访谈与记录核查
shots.transition_out: 电话动作接访谈中景，旁白不断

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. In a quiet 1940s office he interviews one adult witness whose back is toward camera and whose face is never shown. Both seated across a plain wooden table. The investigator listens and writes one small note, respectful and non-accusatory. No handcuffs, no violence, no threatening posture. Stable medium-wide composition.
shots.purpose: 访谈而非审讯定罪；不制造凶手形象
shots.transition_out: 笔停顿后切证据链可视化

shots.purpose: 证据链缺口与无定论的区别
shots.transition_out: 三节点逐次显现，不用夸张闪白

shots.prompt: Close lateral tracking view along archival books and plain case folders of varying ages on a wooden library shelf, warm light fades gently into cool shadow across the shelf, paper edges show the passage of decades. No legible book titles, no faces, no suspect portraits. One smooth continuous move.
shots.purpose: 多年理论出现；不列未经证实姓名
shots.transition_out: 纸张纹理切打字纸，持续低频氛围

shots.prompt: Close view of a vintage black typewriter on a dark desk, two ordinary adult hands type a few slow keystrokes on completely unreadable cream paper. Camera gradually shifts focus from keys to the blank upper paper margin. No legible words generated, restrained tungsten side light.
shots.purpose: 区分吸引人的故事与已证明的事实
shots.transition_out: 仅取前2.7秒整理纸张动作，以纸声接事实边界信息卡

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. The ivory investigation folder lies OPEN with a few cream pages inside, abstract black marks only, no names. One hand in a charcoal suit sleeve gently squares the papers but leaves the folder open. Overhead camera slowly rises; warm lamp and cool shadows maintain continuity. Do not close or seal the file.
shots.purpose: 已知事实汇总；不做结案动作
shots.transition_out: 开放档案形状匹配档案室桌面

shots.prompt: Quiet archive room with rows of wooden document shelves. In the center foreground is the same OPEN ivory case folder on a walnut desk under an emerald-green banker lamp. No people. Slow controlled pullback leaves the open file visible and unresolved. No closing door and no solved stamp.
shots.purpose: 官方资料仍为未解；视觉不暗示已结案
shots.transition_out: 音乐减弱，缓慢切空酒店走廊

shots.prompt: An empty late-1940s grand hotel corridor with cream columns, muted brass fixtures and a tall window at the far end, matching the earlier hotel lobby materials. No people and no supernatural silhouette. Camera gently moves toward the vacant pool of daylight, quiet human absence rather than horror.
shots.purpose: 拒绝虚构凶手；回到人的缺席
shots.transition_out: 同向光线匹配剪辑，配乐连续

shots.prompt: An illustrative adult woman aged twenty-two, dark shoulder-length 1940s pin curls, fair skin, oval face, modest charcoal wool jacket over an ivory blouse, natural muted lipstick, not an actor impersonation, no glamorous pose. Seen FROM BEHIND seated quietly beside a tall window in the same modest 1940s room, her charcoal jacket, ivory collar and dark pin curls remain fixed. She turns her head only a few degrees toward the daylight, never fully revealing her face. Gentle lateral camera drift. Safe, living, dignified human moment; no threatening figure.
shots.purpose: 从案件称呼回到真实的人；避免第二张脸不一致
shots.transition_out: 保持窗侧光方向，切空座与姓名

shots.prompt: A quiet empty wooden chair beside that same tall window and a simple walnut table. On the table stands a small glass vase holding one dark burgundy dahlia flower, a clearly symbolic memorial arrangement, not evidence. Soft late-afternoon light, camera almost imperceptibly pulls back. No person, no writing, no supernatural movement. End in quiet stillness.
shots.purpose: 姓名与年龄；花仅为象征，不冒充案件证物
shots.transition_out: 最后0.8秒音画渐隐，精确180秒结束
